# Wormtown
[color=#999999][italic]...is a parasite festival, with a large supply of antagonistic identities to ensure a party[/italic][/color]
Antagonists: [color=yellowgreen]Parasites[/color]
Key Identities: [color=yellowgreen]Parasites[/color], [color=lime]Arms Dealer[/color], and [color=ruber]Mercenary[/color]
## Summary
There is a slew of guns around, but unlike usual not a single Traitor wielding them. There can be as many starting worms as there usually are starting traitors so it's not unexpected to have a hide variety of infection methods.
As crew, try to identify this masquerade quickly, as worms have the number to gang up and force infections if they get support for it. There will still be some machine hacks, between a Vandal or two or random events, but there will likely be fewer than a typical round and the Parasite's strength is significantly reduced once they are known about if crew still ahs the numbers.
As a parasite, consider teaming up with other parasites or frame each other. You can capitalize on mob mentality to try get one of your allies killed around uninfected crew, or just act as you normally might and try disguise the lack of traitors as much as you can.
It's not abnormal to only really have one or two dominant parasite types after a few infections, and if you know what to expect it's a lot easier to avoid it.
